What is ASTRAH Care?

It is a connected app for astronauts that is used to monitor their health, detect potential illnesses, and alert other crew members. It features vital signs monitoring, a body scanner, a camera, and ultrasound capabilities, as well as a log to store each crew member’s specialized data. This is achieved in a practical way, right at your wrist, through smartwatches customized with the app and other integrated real-time functions, ensuring that astronauts have access to assistance at all times.

But more than just a simple health monitor, ASTRAH Care goes a step further by generating new knowledge, tailored and specialized for different space and personal conditions, through our data storage and anomaly detection API.

What is ASTRAH Care For?

Since astronauts aren’t doctors, obtaining timely information from mission control is complicated; that’s why this app helps them maintain a real-time record and identify the causes of their ailments. Thus, it not only allows them to keep their own records but also helps them monitor the health and vital signs of their crewmates to detect if they’re in danger. Furthermore, the approach we aim to take with ASTRAH Care goes even beyond simply monitoring health and vital signs; we want to provide nutrition plans and exercise routines, as well as measures to identify space-specific issues such as SANS, decalcification, isolation, or radiation.

Furthermore, as part of our future plans, we aim to use the information collected by our API—based on logbooks—as a market model, because ultimately, we must recognize the invaluable nature of this information; there’s no better way to research something than in real time.

There have already been precedents for investments in biomedical analysis—which is precisely what we offer—so it makes sense for this to be our business model.

Of course, we cannot overlook our users’ privacy, which is why we have a terms and conditions clause that users must accept, and we will not disclose the names of the astronauts.

Our Features

Health Monitoring

Check your crewmembers’ health and yours in real time. Check for anomalies and recommendations

Retina Scanner

Checks your eye for color change or disturbances

Body Scan

Revises your body, finds anomalies, tells you what it is and how you may go by treating it (We are not medical experts and can’t give certain information yet)

Relations Between Sicknesses

How all the sicknesses are related to your vital signs, pointing out causes

Immediate Response

Get responses between crewmates, get their vitals and criticality as soon as possible.

Daily Routine

A checklist for your activities and preventive measures

Nutritional Recommendations

Calories, Fat, Vitamin and Protein. Important goals and recommendations to be met

Daily Log

It logs your vital signs and anomalies, sends it back to mission control and saves it in the spaceship

Smart watch compatible

It is able to read some of the vitals through a smart watch, and stay in touch with your crewmembers.
